scenes.title: Mount Fuji
scenes.text: The pack begins with a quiet landmark, loaded as external content through the Narrative Pack contract.
scenes.imageAlt: Mount Fuji rising above a calm landscape under a luminous sky.

scenes.title: Cosmic Whale
scenes.text: A vast celestial passage confirms that the player can render a pack without knowing its story in advance.
scenes.imageAlt: A whale-like cosmic figure crossing a star-filled scene.

scenes.title: Snow Leopards
scenes.text: Each scene references only portable assets inside the pack, keeping the runtime independent.
scenes.imageAlt: Snow leopards standing in a cold mountain environment.

scenes.title: Cosmic Mandala
scenes.text: The same schema links every visual resource through normalized, predictable paths.
scenes.imageAlt: A bright cosmic mandala pattern with layered circular geometry.

scenes.title: Golden Eagle
scenes.text: The renderer receives trusted scene state while asset resolution remains a Core responsibility.
scenes.imageAlt: A golden eagle presented against a dramatic illuminated background.

scenes.title: Traveler Cat
scenes.text: The pack structure leaves room for future audio, video, and icon resources without changing the player.
scenes.imageAlt: A traveling cat character in an adventurous illustrated scene.

scenes.title: Guardian
scenes.text: The import model keeps work-specific choices inside the Narrative Pack boundary.
scenes.imageAlt: A guardian figure standing in a powerful atmospheric scene.

scenes.title: White Cat
scenes.text: The final scene completes the first official asset set for the Immersive Narrative Engine.
scenes.imageAlt: A white cat shown as the focus of a polished illustrative scene.
